items.quote: The officer on whose arm the king was leaning said to the man of God, “Look, even if the Lord should open the floodgates of the heavens, could this happen?” “You will see it with your own eyes,” answered Elisha, “but you will not eat any of it!”
items.contrast: The officer versus the king as the person addressed by Elisha’s “you.”
items.reason: The king is mentioned nearby, so he is a plausible mistaken referent, but Elisha is directly answering the officer’s challenge. The key is therefore unique. However, “eat from the coming sale” is misleading because the officer will not eat the food, not the sale; the stem should ask who will not eat any of the food.
